note: UI Styles CKEditor 5 provides two CKEditor 5 plugins ui_styles_ckeditor5_uiStylesBlock and ui_styles_ckeditor5_uiStylesInline (toolbar items UiStylesBlock/UiStylesInline) that apply UI Styles classes to a block element or an inline <span>. Which styles a button offers is configured per text format and stored in editor.editor.<format> under settings.plugins.ui_styles_ckeditor5_uiStyles{Block,Inline}.enabled_styles (a sequence of style plugin ids; schema ui_styles_ckeditor5_ckeditor5_plugin, NotBlank). No route/permission/settings page. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the live basic_html editor config.

evals.prompt: What does UI Styles CKEditor 5 add to the editor, and what is the difference between its two buttons?
evals.expected_output: It adds two CKEditor 5 toolbar buttons: UI Styles (block) which applies a class to the current block element, and UI Styles (inline) which wraps the selection in a styled <span>. Plugins ui_styles_ckeditor5_uiStylesBlock / ...uiStylesInline.

evals.prompt: How do I choose which UI Styles a CKEditor 5 UI Styles button offers, and where is that stored?
evals.expected_output: Add the button to a text format's CKEditor 5 toolbar, then tick the styles in its settings. The chosen style plugin ids are stored in editor.editor.<format> under settings.plugins.ui_styles_ckeditor5_uiStyles{Block,Inline}.enabled_styles.

evals.prompt: What HTML does the UI Styles CKEditor 5 inline button produce, and where do the editor previews get their CSS?
evals.expected_output: The inline plugin wraps the selection in a <span> carrying the selected style's CSS class (allowed elements include <span> and <$any-html5-element class>). Editor iframe previews use the UI Styles stylesheet generator (/ui_styles/stylesheet).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the 'basic_html' text format has a UI Styles CKEditor 5 button configured to offer a specific style. Inspect the live editor configuration and give the style id listed in that button's enabled_styles.
evals.expected_output: The style id is ui_styles_eval_ckstyle: editor.editor.basic_html settings.plugins.ui_styles_ckeditor5_uiStylesInline.enabled_styles = ['ui_styles_eval_ckstyle']. Read with drush cget editor.editor.basic_html settings.plugins.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the 'basic_html' text format so that a UI Styles CKEditor 5 button (block or inline) offers the style with id 'ui_styles_eval_ck2'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On editor.editor.basic_html, add a UI Styles toolbar button (e.g. UiStylesInline) and set settings.plugins.ui_styles_ckeditor5_uiStylesInline.enabled_styles to include 'ui_styles_eval_ck2' (via the text format's CKEditor 5 settings, or config).
